unresolved: Residual footprint shape/size mismatch discovered during this frame recovery: bounded mesh queries (both near-ground z0-3m and upper-floor z10-14m) place the true west wall of the west wing at x~-13.2 to -14.2 m, about 2-3 m further west than the seed's stated footprint edge x=-11.3 m, at both the north and south ends of that wing. The true north facade (west wing north end and north bar) sits at y~26.2-27.1 m, about 2.2-3.1 m further north than the seed's stated footprint edge y=24.0 m. The east wall (x~19.75-20) and south wall (y~-31.2) match the stated footprint well. Because one edge matches and the opposite edge does not, this is a genuine footprint sizing/shape limitation inherited from the seed geometry, not a pure translation error, and has NOT been corrected here per the frame-recovery scope (numerical room/opening geometry preserved). A future revision should widen/lengthen the west-wing and north-bar footprint polygons (and dependent window spans) toward the true wall lines identified above.
